items.title: Chandrayaan programme
items.snippet_en: The Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed on the Moon on August 23, 2023. India became the first nation to successfully land a spacecraft in the lunar south pole region, and the fourth country to land on the Moon.

India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region. This makes India the fourth country to achieve a moon landing.

India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon on August 22, 2023. The Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft's Vikram lander touched down shortly after 6 pm (1230 BST).

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole, at 69°S, on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC).
India successfully placed a lander in the moon's southern polar region on August 23, 2023, making history as it became the first country to touch down on an uncharted part of the lunar surface.

India made history on August 23, 2023, as its Moon mission became the first to land in the lunar south pole region. The Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down as planned at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT).
